title: Create canonical worksheet schema and fixtures
goal: Create the canonical Worksheet TypeScript type, Zod schema if the eventual TS stack supports it, JSON schema, and fixture worksheets.
context: JSON is the source of truth for worksheet generation, editing, rendering, answer keys, and exports.
acceptance: At least 3 fixture worksheets validate successfully
At least 1 malformed fixture test fails validation
Schema includes worksheet, section, question, answer key, and metadata
Worksheet schema includes id, title, subject, gradeBand, topic, learningGoals, instructions, sections, answerKey, and metadata
Question schema includes the required worksheet compiler question type enum
Schema documents versioning and migration expectations
notes: If no TypeScript stack exists yet, add JSON schema and documented TypeScript definitions without converting the app.
